candidate_evidence.quote: The intervention is a series of 3 guided discussions (using visual aids) between the child's primary oncology physician/nurse team and the child's parent(s)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Child newly diagnosed, i.e., within 16 weeks (112 days) from time of diagnosis of cancer not including the day of diagnosis, OR
Child with relapsed cancer, defined as within 16 weeks (112 days) of first-time relapse/evidence of progression of disease
